main_text.l: Curiosi exploratores] Curiosus idem ac delator.
Currere] Cursum aliquò tendere, Liv. Contendere cursum, Plaut. Contendere ad, in. Contendere iter. Ferri, Cic. Ferri rapidè, Virg. Meare, Lucr. Ingredi cursim.
Curriculo currere] Volare. Rapere se. Inflammato studio rapitur classis, Cic. Contendere magnis itineribus, Caf. Passibus rapidis ferri, Virg. Cursu magno, Cic. Admisso passu sequi, Ovid.
Curriculum] Stadium, Cic. Xystus, Vitr. Curriculum stadii, Gell. Circus, Cic. Agonium, Scal. Campus Martius, Caf. Stadiodromus, pro loco Robert. Heptastadium, Amm. Hiera, Sen. Media linea in stadio.
In Curriculo currere] Curriculum conficere. Abire curriculo. Stadium currere, Cic.
Currus] Rheda, Cic. Quadrigæ, Hor. Quadrijugus currus, Virg. Bijuge curriculum, Suet. Sarracum, Juv.
Cursus] Curriculum lunæ, Cic. Cursura, Varr. Meatus, Lucr.
Cursor publicus] Gerulus literarum, Plaut. Servus à pedibus, Cic. Hemerodromus, Liv. Armillati cursores.
Curvare] Inflectere ferrum, Caf. Lentare arcum, Ovid. Arcuare, Plin. Cornuare, Varr. Concurvare, Macr. Obliquare, Stat. Lunare, Ouid. Detorquere, Virg. Delimare, Varr.

Curvatio] Curvatura. Incurvatio. Pravitas & distorsio membrorum. Obliquitas lineæ, Plin. Flexus pulli, Col. Flexura vicorum, Suet. Distortio, Cic. Flexuosa radicum, Pallad. Anfractus viarum, Caf. Curvor, Varr. Cornua maris, i. curvitates, Ovid.

Curvus] Incurva arbor, Plin. Flexuosus, Cic. Obliquus, Hor. Sinuosus, Ovid. Distortus, Cic. Obstipus, Col. Indirectus, Quint. Torvus, Perf. Procurvus, Virg. Conflexum jugum montis. In anfractum convoluta cornua, Plin. Pravus. Pandus, Ovid. Enormis, Tacit. Limulus, Plaut. Limus, & Limis, Fest.
